messages.subject: Run App Button missing
parts:
Hello all,

I am using the latest version of RStudio (Version 0.98.507 – © 2009-2013 RStudio, Inc.), but there is no RunApp button in the ui.R menu of the editor. This is a very convenient button! Is there something to be done to make it appear?

Thank you in advance for your help,

Kind regards,

Thomas

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Run App Button missing
parts:
Cool ! I didn't know this feature. 
Did you do 
File -> New Project -> New/Existing Directory -> Shiny Web Application ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Run App Button missing
parts:
That is not necessary. RStudio can recognize any ui.R/server.R and
show that button, but this requires a later version than 0.98.507. At
the moment, you can check out the preview version of RStudio, but
please note that the preview version is not guaranteed to be stable,
and you are welcome to use it for testing purposes.

Regards,
Yihui
